intro: This 12-day Prenatal & Postnatal Yoga Teacher Training Course in Bali guides you through anatomy, birth philosophy, Ayurveda, and ancient knowledge which can help mother and child to be healthy. The course will help you to guide women through the birthing process calmly and confidently. It also delves into post-partum depression and the methods of meditation that assist mothers to soothe their body and mind after birth.

Teachers leave standard 200-hour training without ever having received training on how to adapt a pose for a woman in her 3rd trimester, or how to talk to a new mom who is emotionally unwell after childbirth. This course is designed for yoga teachers, doulas, health care professionals and mothers themselves to be able to enter into this work realistically, not randomly.

curriculum.title: Yoga Philosophy of Pregnancy
curriculum.summary: We examine pregnancy from the classical yogic perspective, and understand how the mind, body and spirit work together during this phase, and how this will impact teaching.

curriculum.title: Reproductive Anatomy and Physiology
curriculum.summary: A strong foundation of the physical changes a woman experiences so that every adjustment and pose you teach is based on knowledge, not assumption.

curriculum.title: Postures for the Prenatal and Postnatal Body
curriculum.summary: Instead of a single sequence, you will learn different sets of postures that are appropriate for the prenatal and postnatal body, working on strength, flexibility and body awareness for each stage.

curriculum.title: Nutrition Through Pregnancy
curriculum.summary: How food affects the mother's health and her baby's growth and development, and suggestions for what to eat and what to avoid.

curriculum.title: Garbhopanishad
curriculum.summary: This ancient scripture gives an unusually detailed account of the spiritual and biological progress of a fetus and the lessons contained within it are still relevant today.

curriculum.title: Pranayama for Prenatal Support
curriculum.summary: Learn unique breathing techniques to release stress from the body, quieten the emotions and connect mother and baby during pregnancy.

curriculum.title: Pre and Postnatal Care Psychotherapy
curriculum.summary: Understand the significance of emotional and psychological health and healing during the period of pregnancy and postpartum healing, and what yoga teachers can do to be able to hold space compassionately.

curriculum.title: Mantra, Meditation and Connection with the Unborn Child
curriculum.summary: Practices for connecting to the unborn child, utilizing sound and stillness, with a conscious and sacred relationship for the mother prior to the birth of her child.

curriculum.title: Teaching Methodology
curriculum.summary: The actual process of arranging, organizing and modifying prenatal and postnatal classes in a safe, clear and supportive way, and the process of being able to confidently communicate with a client who may be vulnerable or uncertain.

prerequisites: No previous yoga experience is necessary.
Pregnant women, whether early in pregnancy or further along, who want to feel more prepared and grounded for what's ahead, and who want practical tools they can use on their own.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Deposits are non-refundable but can be transferred to another upcoming course at Bali Yoga School. The deposit remains valid for a lifetime and may be used toward future training programs.

policies.title: Management Authority
items: The management team is authorised to make the necessary changes in the daily schedule if needed.

policies.title: Course Booking & Confirmation
items: To book for the course, please deposit the complete course fees of 100 USD. An official confirmation letter for your program will be sent shortly after successful payment.

policies.title: Asanas Class
items: The purpose of the asana classes is to support your body and mind. These sessions promote personal well-being rather than provide professional-level training in asanas or alignment techniques.

policies.title: 1 Hour Self Practice
items: You can engage in a one-hour self-practice session in the HYA Healing Studio using available instruments. Any damage to equipment during practice must be covered by you.

policies.title: Important Note
items: The school reserves the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.

faqs.q: Does this course meet the requirements of Yoga Alliance?
faqs.a: Yes, our Prenatal & Postnatal Yoga Teacher Training Course at Himalayan Yoga Association is Yoga Alliance accredited.

faqs.q: Is it possible to participate when I am in my first trimester?
faqs.a: Yes. Our course is well designed to suit the pregnant women at all the three trimesters, with relevant adjustments.

faqs.q: What is the length of the course?
faqs.a: To see the latest batch times and dates, call us directly.

faqs.q: Is it possible that my partner can enroll?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We also embrace parents and even provide free couple guidance sessions in the program.
Yes, we do provide face-to-face training in Rishikesh as well as the online form of the course.

faqs.q: Should I have any prior yoga experience?
faqs.a: No prior yoga training is required to enroll in this course.
